entries.reason: Re-reviewed 2026-09-19: the affected legacy Rustls/WebPKI verifier remains confined to the Esplora client, which reviewed production source never constructs. Native source/features/dependency identities are unchanged. Active Electrum connections use a controlled loopback relay with Java TLS for TLS-required modes; the patched modern native Rustls/WebPKI capability remains bundled. Checksum-verified minreq exposes no CRL configuration in its TLS module. Legacy code is not claimed removed; see exact source and full-advisory review.
